title: Light fittings sourcing shortlist
note: All prices in AUD, before freight and duty. Supplier quotes given in USD are converted at 1 USD = 1.425 AUD (23 Oct 2026).

groups.quoted: Quoted through the inquiry, no listing

items.name: Made By Mayfair Amalfi 5 Light Pendant
items.catch: The integrated LED has a 3000K minimum, so it can't do the 2700K the rest of the house is on. Going custom fixes this, because we supply our own globes.

items.name: August Oval Pendant
items.description: Chalk white with opal glass. SKU 011971.
specs: ES lampholder x1, max 45W, globe not included

items.name: Odelia Pendant
items.description: Walnut timber with bronze and sepia glass. SKU 012003.

items.name: Wirth 5 Light 600mm Pendant
specs: SES lampholders x5, max 5W each, globes sold separately

items.name: Villa Spanish Marble Stone Pendant
items.description: The flattened pebble shape that started the whole search. Everything since has been measured against it.
specs: Metal and marble, 3500K, switch control, 3-year warranty
items.supplier: Zhongshanshi Jianyi Dengshichang, Zhongshan. 6 years, 4.7/5 from 389 reviews, #8 best seller in Chandeliers & Pendant Lights, under 2h response, 98% on-time dispatch, 38% reorder rate
items.catch: Smaller than we want. The shape is right, the size isn't.

items.name: Cross-border Spanish Marble and Copper Pendant
items.price_note: At 2–99 pieces, currently 10% off from A$64.50. A$38.87 at 100+. Sample A$57.59
items.supplier: Zhongshan Weifeng (Dary Xiao). 100% on-time dispatch, sells to Australia
items.status: In conversation. He's checking whether he can do plain E27 instead of integrated LED, and whether a larger shade is possible. Quoting us for 2 and 3 pieces.

items.name: Amber Murano Style Glass Disc Chandelier
items.description: The big amber one. Genuinely large: the smallest size is already 600mm.
specs: Glass and stainless steel, 3500K, switch control
items.supplier: Zhongshan Heroic Lion (Kristie Lu). Only 1 year on the platform, which is the risk here
items.catch: Expensive, and a young supplier. The 600mm version alone costs more than the Loch and Odelia put together.

items.name: BGST Wabi Sabi Three-Layer Fabric Pendant
items.price_note: Minimum order 5 pieces. Custom packaging from A$35.99
items.description: Closest thing found so far to the Wirth linen look, though much larger.
items.supplier: Zhongshan Biggest (Ricki Luo). Verified, 7 years, 4.9/5 from 116 reviews, 100% on-time dispatch

items.name: Modern Amber and Smoky Glass Pendant
items.description: Two colours: amber, and "cigarette ash" smoky grey.
items.catch: Small. Size is listed only as "Standard". We've asked what the maximum is; at eleven dollars it's worth knowing.

items.name: PM Modern Minimalist Smoky Grey Glass Pendant
items.price_note: For 1–9, currently 11% off from A$37.15. A$30.75 for 10–99
items.supplier: Shenzhen Pingmei (Abel Zhao). 4.4/5 from 270 reviews, 100% on-time dispatch, sells to Australia

items.name: French Mid-century Post-modern Chandelier
items.price_note: Quoted A$214 (USD 150) in the inquiry; listed at A$215.94 for 1–99. Effectively list price, so the real negotiation hasn't started
items.description: The amber one Alex Li quoted us on. 600 x 280mm, which clears our size floor comfortably.
specs: 5.0 from 1 review, 23 sold, #1 most popular in Mid-Century Chandeliers & Pendant Lights
items.supplier: Shenzhen Wenly Lighting (Alex Li). 98% on-time dispatch, sells to Australia

items.name: Amber Pond Lily mouth-blown glass shade
items.description: Amber blown glass, mouth blown, handmade. 100–240V, shipped in hard carton with foam.
items.supplier: Yan Betty, Huizhou Shunda Lighting & Glass Factory (est. 2000). Best lead: offered the pebble shape and alabaster veining in one piece
items.catch: The listed piece is a small table-lamp cylinder on an E14 filament bulb. The pebble would be a custom job, which she has offered to do.
items.status: Waiting on prices and photos of the glass lit from inside.

items.name: VEKO VP-009 Alabaster and Copper pendant
items.description: Genuine alabaster with copper. CE RoHS, 3500K, 3-year warranty, adjustable height.
items.catch: Only comes in 150mm and 180mm, less than half our floor, and CRI is 80 where the plan calls for 90+. Ruled out on size, but a useful data point: small alabaster still costs A$184 a piece.

items.name: Metal frame amber ribbed glass single pendant
items.price_note: A$285 (USD 200) per piece at 3 or more
items.description: Metal frame with amber ribbed glass.
items.catch: No size given yet, which is the first thing we need. We've pushed back on the price.
